question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
gold: SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING post_count > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
gold0: SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING post_count > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

c.request:
What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
Evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))
Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
c.sql: WITH prolific_users AS (SELECT u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id GROUP BY u.Id HAVING COUNT(p.OwnerUserId) > 10) SELECT 1.0 * SUM(UpVotes) / COUNT(Id) AS average_up_votes, 1.0 * SUM(Age) / COUNT(Id) AS average_age FROM prolific_users

b.request: Using a left join that retains users without matching posts, report the average UpVotes and average Age of users who authored more than 10 posts
b.sql: SELECT AVG(UpVotes) AS AvgUpVotes, AVG(Age) AS AvgAge FROM (SELECT u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id GROUP BY u.Id HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10) AS qualifying_users

d.request: What are the average up votes and average user age for users who created more than 10 posts, including rows with no matching record in the joined table?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(UpVotes) AS AverageUpVotes, AVG(Age) AS AverageUserAge FROM (SELECT u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id GROUP BY u.Id HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10) AS qualifying_users;
